municipality.label: Adjuntas
municipality.notes: Display name is mapped from the official Puerto Rico municipality boundary dataset in Datos.PR using countyfp to municipio.

selection.selectionBasis: Filter municipality-level CBP facts by one category NAICS code and one municipality code.

cbpFacts.notes: Payroll and employment values are disclosure-limited in this row and should be interpreted as constrained context.

rationale: Category mapping is candidate-grade and requires human review before production use.
The selected fact row matches municipality code and NAICS code deterministically.
Disclosure-limited payroll and employment values reduce confidence for planning interpretation.

limitations: This fixture is descriptive planning context only and is not a site recommendation.
The row does not include NAICS title text, so category naming currently comes from the crosswalk.
A single row is not enough for demand, viability, profitability, or permitting conclusions.
unresolvedQuestions: Should the planning-context municipality registry expand to every Puerto Rico fipscty code before additional fixtures are added?
Should establishment counts inherit a visible qualifier when payroll and employment stay disclosure-limited in the same row?
What deterministic policy should map missing CBP NAICS title text into user-facing labels?
